g.text: 120 measured runs · six configurations · five repetitions at each context · 256 generated tokens per run
Points/lines: medians. Whiskers: observed minimum–maximum, not confidence intervals.
Exact inputs: 8,192 / 32,768 / 131,072 / 200,000 tokens. Model load and tokenization excluded; timing boundaries differ by runtime.
Same M5; different models, precisions and runtimes. No matched M3 measurement or general quality ranking is implied.
